modelOutput.text: {"isMultiStep":true,"difficulty":"moderate","steps":[{"objective":"Read the total revenue value shown on the Sales Dashboard page.","successCriteria":"Sales Dashboard heading visible and Total Revenue metric value visible","dependencies":[],"assumptions":["The current page is the Sales Dashboard tab."],"verifyAfter":{"trigger":"Total Revenue metric value visible on Sales Dashboard","action":"advance_step"},"toolProfile":"read_only","expectedState":{"description":"The Sales Dashboard is visible with summary metric cards including a Total Revenue value.","urlPattern":"dashboard-sales","expectedPhrases":["Sales Dashboard","Total Revenue"]}},{"objective":"Switch from the Sales Dashboard tab to the Support Dashboard tab.","successCriteria":"Support Dashboard heading visible and page shows support metrics","dependencies":[0],"assumptions":["A Support Dashboard tab or navigation control is available from the current dashboard."],"verifyAfter":{"trigger":"Support Dashboard heading visible","action":"advance_step"},"toolProfile":"navigate","expectedState":{"description":"The dashboard view has changed from sales metrics to support metrics.","expectedPhrases":["Support Dashboard"]}},{"objective":"Read the open ticket count shown on the Support Dashboard page and report both the Total Revenue number and the Open Tickets number.","successCriteria":"Support Dashboard heading visible and Open Tickets metric value visible","dependencies":[1],"assumptions":["The Support Dashboard contains a metric labeled Open Tickets or equivalent."],"verifyAfter":{"trigger":"Open Tickets metric value visible on Support Dashboard","action":"call_done"},"toolProfile":"read_only","expectedState":{"description":"The Support Dashboard is visible with support-related metric cards including the Open Tickets count.","expectedPhrases":["Support Dashboard","Open Tickets"]}}]}
